dataset.name: JUMP Cell Painting, cpg0016 source_13 CRISPR plates (Cell Painting Gallery)
dataset.license_quoted: Cell Painting Gallery README: "All the data is released with CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)."
dataset.attribution: Images: JUMP Cell Painting Consortium, Cell Painting Gallery cpg0016-jump, source_13 (CC0 1.0); plates CP-CC9-R1-01, CP-CC9-R2-01, CP-CC9-R3-01, sites 4-6 of wells A02 and A23; DNA channel only.
dataset.citation: Chandrasekaran SN et al. Morphological map of under- and overexpression of genes in human cells. Nature Methods 22, 1742-1752 (2025). doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02753-9
dataset.scope: U2OS-311 (Cas9) cells, 96 h after transfection with pooled CRISPR guides; Cell Painting. Yokogawa CV7000, confocal, NA 0.75, 0.65 um/px (JUMP microscope_config.csv), 1280 x 1080 px, single plane, uint16 TIFF. Channel: Hoechst 33342 (DNA, C01).
dataset.modifications: None to pixel values or image size (1280 x 1080): one of the five channels (DNA) is used, re-saved as an uncompressed single-plane TIFF.
caveats: Run1–Run3 は、バッチ 20220914_Run1、20221009_Run2、20221017_Run3 のプレート CP-CC9-R1-01、R2-01、R3-01 です。出典は各プレートを播種から 96 時間で固定したと述べていますが、別々に播種・導入・染色した独立した実験であるとは明記していません。日付から独立性を推定しないため、デモでは独立性を未確認として扱い、検定をしません。
日付はバッチ名の日付です。撮影日かどうかは出典に書かれていません。
各実験回・各条件で 1 ウェル 3 視野（3 × 3 の中央の行、視野 4〜6）です。ウェルは公開されたプレート配置の対照 A02（non-targeting）と A23（PLK1）です。視野は核の数や値で選んでいません。比較は実験回ごとの値と差による記述です。
核数は視野に写った核の数で、生存率や増殖率そのものではありません。PLK1 のノックアウトでは大きく不規則な核や、断片化した核の塊も見え、塊は小さな物体に分かれて検出・計数されることがあります。両群に同じ検出を当て、物体の大きさによる除外はしていません。デモでは核の形を解釈しません。
デモの数値は公開画像による例示で、研究室の画像での妥当性を示すものではありません。
デモのAI解析案は、例文に対して用意した設定案を返します（外部AIは呼び出しません）。

reported_change.source: Chandrasekaran ら 2025、Nature Methods、Methods「Within-plate controls」：“CRISPR plates – PLK1; knocking it down kills cells.”
reported_change.comparison: 同じプレートの PLK1 ノックアウトと non-targeting（標的のないガイド）
reported_change.direction: PLK1 のノックアウトで細胞が死ぬ（視野の核が減る）
reported_change.quantity: 出典は向きだけを述べ、視野あたりの核数の変化量は報告していません
reported_change.scope: 核は Hoechst から数えます。核数は画像に写った核の数で、生存率そのものではありません。値は視野 → 試料 → 実験回の順にまとめています。
reported_change.independence: Run1–Run3 は日付の異なるバッチの別のプレートです。出典は各プレートを播種から 96 時間で固定したと述べていますが、別々に播種・導入・染色した独立した実験であるとは明記していません。このため、この場面では検定と信頼区間を計算せず、実験回ごとの値と差を示します。

scenes.derivation_rule: Pre-registered before any measurement (this manifest is committed before the scenario runs). Plates: the first replicate plate map CP-CC9-R1/R2/R3-01 of source_13, one per batch Run1, Run2, Run3 (the first three batches). Wells: A02 (non-targeting, JCP2022_800002) and A23 (PLK1, JCP2022_805264), the row-A controls of plate-map columns 2 and 23 (JUMP metadata well.csv.gz and crispr.csv.gz). Site: 5 (F005, the centre of the 3 x 3 sites), for every well (amended to sites 4-6, see derivation_amendment). Channels: DNA and RNA. No field, nucleus or object is chosen or removed by its count, size or signal. Before this rule was fixed, site 2 of A02 and A23 on CP-CC9-R1-01 and CP-CC9-R3-01 was viewed to confirm that the images are available and show the reported change; site 5 was not viewed or measured before the rule was committed.
scenes.derivation_amendment: Amendment recorded before publication: the approved requirement D-08 asks for at least three fields per group and run, so sites 4 and 6 (with site 5 the centre row of the 3 x 3 sites; F004-F006 in the published file names) were added for every well. The site-5 nuclei-per-field result (Run1-Run3: 471/244/376 non-targeting, 37/44/45 PLK1) had been computed before this amendment; the added sites are fixed by position only, not by any measured value, and no site is removed. The comparison plan is unchanged.

selection.rule: fixed plates, wells and site; no measurement-based selection

scenario_notes.unit_definition: 実験回（Run1–Run3。日付の異なるバッチの別のプレート）
scenario_notes.pairing_basis: 同じ実験回（プレート）の対照と PLK1 ノックアウト
scenario_notes.design_note: Each run (plate) contains both conditions, so conditions are paired by run: experimental unit = one condition within one run, pair = run. Independence of the runs is unconfirmed, so the comparison is descriptive (no test).
scenario_notes.grid_notes: Nuclei: full 3 x 3 grid of StarDist probability (0.4/0.5/0.6) and NMS (0.2/0.3/0.4) at the automatic detection scale on all fields. Nucleoli are not detected: at 0.65 um/px the dataset is not suited to nucleolar segmentation, so the nucleolar and nucleoplasm views are not offered. Cellpose-SAM cell ROI is not recorded.
scenario_notes.comparison_plan: Planned before measurement: nuclei per field (field-summary 1.0.0, StarDist nuclei on Hoechst with default settings, nuclei touching the border included), PLK1 KO − non-targeting, paired by run, paired t-test, comparison estimates (difference and geometric-mean ratio with 95% intervals). Expected direction from the source: fewer nuclei after PLK1 knockout. No threshold on the effect size is set; a result in the other direction will be reported as such. Amended before publication at the owner's decision (2026-10-25): the runs' independence is unconfirmed (requirements E-05), so the comparison is descriptive (common statistics test none): per-run values and differences, no test, p-value or interval; the planned association is not computed.

experiment.independence_basis: Not confirmed by the source: the batches are weeks apart and each plate was fixed 96 h after seeding, but separate seeding, transfection and staining are not stated (requirements E-05: no inference from dates).

proposals.note: Demo-authored analysis drafts for preset instructions; no language model was called. Each draft is returned through the production proposal route and validated by validate_draft.
presets: 核の数と面積を視野ごとに確認したい
核の面積を対照とPLK1ノックアウトで比較したい

dataset.name: DS6a_5EU_Pulse_RawData (Schmidt, Rohatgi, Brandman 2022)
dataset.license_quoted: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (Zenodo record metadata: license id cc-by-4.0)
dataset.attribution: Images: Schmidt HB, Rohatgi R, Brandman O (2022), DS6a_5EU_Pulse_RawData, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6643470, CC BY 4.0; 640 x 640 crops placed on the Hoechst stain, channels Hoechst, NPM1 and 5-EU.
dataset.citation: Schmidt HB et al. Oxaliplatin disrupts nucleolar function through biophysical disintegration. Cell Reports 2022. doi:10.1016/j.celrep.2022.111629
dataset.scope: U2OS cells with endogenous FBL-sfGFP and NPM1-mTagRFP knock-ins, 1 h untreated or 1 µM actinomycin D, then a 30 min 5-EU pulse labelled with Alexa Fluor 647 azide; Hoechst nuclear stain. Olympus IX83 widefield, 40x/1.4 oil, 0.1625 um/px, single plane, uint16 OME-TIFF.
dataset.modifications: 640 x 640 crop of each 2304 x 2304 plane, placed where the Hoechst stain covers the most area (the same window for all channels); channels Hoechst (OME c3), NPM1-mTagRFP (OME c1) and 5-EU (OME c2, Cy5); pixel values unchanged; re-saved as uncompressed single-plane TIFF.
caveats: このデモで測った核小体の平均 5-EU（核ごと、背景補正なし）は、ActD − 未処理の差が反復ごとに +263、−83、−1317 で、論文の報告（ActD でほぼ消失）と向きがそろいません。論文の値は核小体ごとの 5-EU を NPM1 で割ったもので、デモの値とは定義と集約が異なります。画像では、未処理で核小体に点状に集まる 5-EU が、ActD では核全体に広がって見えます。
Rep1–Rep3 は同じ日（2021-12-01）に連番で撮影されています。独立した実験であることは出典で確認できないため、この場面では推測統計を行いません。
各反復・各条件で、ファイル名の順に最初の 3 視野を使います。各画像から 640 × 640 画素（104 µm 角）を、核染色（Hoechst）が最も多く写る位置で切り出しています（NPM1 と 5-EU は見ていません）。視野や核を信号で選んだり除いたりはしていません。
核小体は NPM1 の分布から決めます。ActD では NPM1 の一部が核質へ移るため、核小体の輪郭は NPM1 の分布も反映します。
核小体が決まらない核があると、その視野の核小体の統計を計算できません。画像の端で欠けた核や核の断片（視野の核の面積の中央値の 0.6 倍未満）でそうなったものだけを、画面の「選択領域を削除」と同じ操作で核から除いています（3 個。一覧は manifest.json の scenario.fragment_review）。
論文の図の 5-EU は核小体の面積あたり・核小体ごとの値で、デモの核小体の平均 5-EU（核ごと）とは単位と正規化が異なります。比べるのは変化の向きです。
デモの数値は公開画像による例示で、研究室の画像での妥当性を示すものではありません。
デモのAI解析案は、例文に対して用意した設定案を返します（外部AIは呼び出しません）。

reported_change.source: Schmidt ら 2022、Cell Reports、Figure 5A–B と本文：ActD は “both completely inhibited transcription and demixed nucleoli”。Fig 5B は核小体の 5-EU 平均と核小体の離心率（各条件 713 個以上の核小体）
reported_change.comparison: 未処理と ActD 1 µM（1 時間）の後、5-EU を 30 分取り込ませた U2OS
reported_change.direction: ActD で核小体の 5-EU（新しく合成された RNA）がほぼ消え、核小体が丸くなる（離心率が下がる）
reported_change.quantity: 論文は箱ひげ図で示し、本文で「完全に止まる」と述べています。図の数値は核小体ごとの値で、Cytellect の核ごと・視野ごとの値とは単位が異なります
reported_change.scope: 核小体は NPM1 で決め、5-EU は別のチャンネルで測ります。論文の図の 5-EU は核小体の面積あたり（著者のコードでは NPM1 で割った値）で、デモの平均 5-EU とは定義が異なります。
reported_change.independence: Rep1–Rep3 は同じ日に連番で撮影されており、独立した実験であることは出典で確認できません。このため、この場面では検定をせず、群ごとの分布と実験回ごとの値を示します。

scenes.derivation_rule: Pre-registered before any measurement of this scene: the 18 files fixed by fixtures/public/group-comparison/ds6a-manifest.json (Codex, PR #99): for Untreated and ActD1, the first three files of each replicate Rep1–Rep3 in file-name order. Each plane is cropped to 640 x 640 pixels (for the published seed size) by crop_rule (see derivation_amendment). Channels: Hoechst (c3), NPM1 (c1), 5-EU (c2). No field, nucleus or object is selected or removed by its count, size or signal; nuclei without an established nucleolus remain missing for nucleolar measures, never zero.
scenes.derivation_amendment: Amended after the first scenario run, before any nucleolar or 5-EU value was read: the pre-registered centre crops held 0-2 nuclei in four of the 18 fields (Rep1 ActD file 52, Rep2 ActD file 112, Rep3 Untreated files 121 and 122); in Rep3 Untreated file 122 the crop held no nucleus and StarDist returned 51 objects in the cytoplasm, which left the field's nucleolar compartments unresolved and stopped the build. The crop position is now chosen per field from the nuclear stain alone (crop_rule). The 18 files, channels, groups, runs and every later rule are unchanged; no field is removed. Second amendment, after the re-cropped scenario run and before any nucleolar or 5-EU value was read: three nuclei at the crop border had no established nucleolus (152, 2079 and 3222 px; 0.03, 0.49 and 0.58 of their field's median nuclear area), which leaves those fields' compartments unresolved. The build's existing fragment review (scenario.fragment_review, used by the earlier public demo of this dataset) is applied: an unresolved object smaller than 0.6 of its field's median nuclear area is deleted from the nuclei, as the workspace's region deletion does, and listed in manifest.json (scenario.fragment_review); any larger unresolved nucleus stops the build.

selection.rule: first three files per replicate and condition in file-name order; crop by crop_rule

scenario_notes.unit_definition: 反復（Rep1–Rep3。独立性は出典で確認できない）
scenario_notes.pairing_basis: 同じ反復（Rep）の未処理と ActD
scenario_notes.grid_notes: Nuclei: StarDist probability and NMS grid on all fields. Nucleoli: the stable nucleolar-marker definition (cytellect-nucleolar-v2) on NPM1 runs in the browser for any nuclear result. Cellpose-SAM is not recorded.
scenario_notes.comparison_plan: Planned before measurement: per-field distributions of the nucleolar mean 5-EU (raw and background-corrected) and of the nucleolar eccentricity (compartment-summary 1.1.0), Untreated versus ActD 1 µM, by replicate. Expected directions from the source: lower nucleolar 5-EU and lower eccentricity with ActD. No inferential test is reported because the replicates' independence is not established. Amended before any value was read (2026-10-25): the common statistics gained a descriptive comparison (test none) for designs whose independence is unconfirmed; the scene opens on that comparison of the nucleolar mean 5-EU (per-run values and differences, no test, p-value or interval). Result as planned (2026-10-25): ActD − untreated nucleolar mean 5-EU per run +263, −83, −1317 (Rep1–3), not the direction the paper reports; the paper's EU/NPM1 per nucleolus differs in definition and aggregation. An exploratory nucleoplasm/nucleolus 5-EU ratio examined after this result is not published; the scene keeps the planned metric.

experiment.independence_basis: Not confirmed by the source: Rep1–Rep3 were imaged on the same date in one numbered sequence.

proposals.note: Demo-authored analysis drafts for preset instructions; no language model was called. Each draft is returned through the production proposal route and validated by validate_draft.
